svg.desc: Hey there, I'm Sruthi Raghavan. ML Engineer, Computer Vision, Vision-Language Systems, UI and 3D Design. A girl with long wavy dark-brown hair in a violet NYU t-shirt sips a steaming mug of coffee beside a laptop showing the code while (coffee) { code(); learn(); build(); }
